reason: PURE. The sachets caught my eye first, pocket-sized and one hand to open, I can toss one in my gym bag or the diaper bag, and the "Every batch lab-tested" QR on the front made it feel legit. I'd skip the Complex because 3 forms looks thin next to the 8 or 14 form ones I see, so I'd just take the simple one for sleep and stress.
objection: $29.99 is a lot for one month of magnesium when I can get a big bottle at the store for less, and I don't know this brand yet.
would_change_my_mind: A lower first-box price or a discount on the first order, or a bigger creator telling me it really helped their sleep.
